deferred_source_units.source_text: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the Lord spoke through Haggai the prophet, saying:
deferred_source_units.reason: The complete date heading, the twenty-first day of month seven, was read in its native order. No sufficiently particular parallel for this dated message was established; a generic revelation heading is not counted as a supported connection.

unresolved_candidates.source_text: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the Lord spoke through Haggai the prophet, saying:
unresolved_candidates.reason: Ezra supplies Darius's second year as the end of suspended temple work but does not identify the seventh month's twenty-first day given in this source unit. The broad rebuilding chronology was not retained as a distinct match for this date heading.

target_units.text: Then the work of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and it remained idle until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.
